title: Guonian Zhe Lianmeng: Nu Wa Ci Fu

alternative_titles.ja: 过年者联盟之女娲赐福

synopsis:
Peace reigns throughout the land in celebration of the Year of the Snake, the auspicious serpent bestows its blessings upon the world!

The moon's new cycle heralds a new era, the stars shine brightly, and the Luo Blade governs the eight wastelands!

With the Lunar New Year of the Snake approaching, Sparkly Key Animation Studio, along with its series, wish our dear viewers a prosperous Year of the Snake and all the best!

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
